stage: frozen before reading target historical source, commit body or repair diff
question: Can a single-revision, direct typed-field producer check propose useful host-to-endian assignment review leads in a different subsystem while refusing unrelated or unsupported forms?
input_boundary: Each run receives exactly one old Git revision and one metadata-selected path. The scanner may follow at most two levels of quoted local includes within that same revision; no fix revision or title is an input.

targets.metadata_role: different-subsystem endian-warning candidate; exact direction unknown
configuration-authority scope control; scan both changed C files

predeclared_interpretation: A candidate requires a direct assignment of a host-typed scalar to a recognized __le/__be struct member and later same-function address passing of that object. This is a review lead only; the call and protocol still need manual confirmation.
Normal applies only to an analyzed assignment with same-representation value, explicit conversion or zero value. It does not clear the whole source file or commit.

Zero recognized assignments means this rule is out of scope for that path; unsupported syntax, declaration or caller evidence remains insufficient. Missing source or unhandled execution failure is runner_error.

All raw results and hashes must be saved before looking at the target commit body, diff, or historical source for truth review. Any rule change after a target is opened turns that target into development data.

One independent causal chain is the counting unit, not multiple assignments or changed files. Purposeful fixed-500 selection and prior model-short-decision history preclude population accuracy or speed claims.
